sources.title: openSMILE 3.0 | audEERING
sources.snippet: openSMILE (open-source Speech and Music Interpretation by Large-space Extraction) is an open-source toolkit for audio feature extraction and classification of speech and music signals. openSMILE is widely applied in automatic expression recognition for affective computing. openSMILE is free to use for research purposes.
